author: CNN
description:
The White House is working to quickly upgrade the Qatari-donated jet that has newly started serving as Air Force One, a development that comes after administration officials internally discussed the need for President Donald Trump to avoid flying it in high-threat areas, according to two sources familiar with the matter.

The extent of the required upgrades, which will be made later this fall, remains unclear. But the two sources said that before Trump traveled on the jet to Turkey earlier this month, officials had discussed the president not traveling on the newly refurbished jet to areas that could pose a higher risk to him, specifically Israel, amid the monthslong war with Iran.

CNN goes over what enhancements the jet may be undergoing and the NewsNight panel discusses the issues surrounding the Qatari gifted plane.

2:12 Was the plane cleared for use too quickly?
6:23 NewsNight Panel: Was Trump right to go after journalists over AF1 rep
title: 'Planemaxxing': Trump is rushing to upgrade Qatari AF1 jet again

description:
The Iran-backed Houthi group in Yemen has declared its own maritime blockade on Saudi shipping, an escalation that could reignite yet another dormant regional conflict and threaten global oil supplies. 

The Houthis, one of Iran’s principal allies in the region, have long warned they could take action to block the Bab al Mandab Strait, a chokepoint at the southern end of the Red Sea. 

The closure of the strategic waterway could significantly disrupt global trade and further roil oil markets. 

Retired major general James "Spider" Marks, CNN's Nic Robertson, CNN's David Goldman and Bloomberg Middle East Geoeconomics lead Dina Esfandiary have more on the implications of a second key shipping lane getting caught up in the Iran conflict. 

0:00 Retired general details the Houthis' operational strength 
2:59 CNN international diplomatic editor on the fallout from the Houthis' blockade 
4:04 What impact could the blockade have on the global oil market? 
6:15 Middle East analyst explains wh
title: Houthis announce Red Sea blockade of Saudi shipping

David Brouillette has not responded to several requests from CNN for comment. The DHS has declined to identify the officer behind this shooting, only saying, "The ICE officer in question has nearly a decade of federal law enforcement experience with required training.”
